info.title: Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud) API
info.description:
Write records to Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud), read unified profiles and calculated insights back, and trigger the identity resolution and insight runs that build them.

The `Runs` operations (Connect REST API) are served by the core Salesforce org at `https://{myDomain}/services/data/{apiVersion}` with the org's OAuth 2.0 access token. Every other operation is served by the Data Cloud tenant endpoint with a Data Cloud token, obtained by exchanging the org's access token at `POST https://{myDomain}/services/a360/token`; the exchange also returns the tenant endpoint.

servers.description: Data Cloud tenant endpoint (the `instance_url` from the a360 token exchange).

post.description:
Queues records for asynchronous upsert (processed about every 3 minutes). Max 200 KB per request.
**Every field defined in the object's schema must be present in each record**, whether or not it
is marked required; send a blank value when there's no data. An update replaces the whole record.

delete.summary: Delete records by primary key via streaming ingestion
delete.description: Deletes up to 200 records by primary key, passed in the request body. For more than 200, use a bulk job with `operation: delete`.

post.summary: Validate records against the object schema without ingesting them
post.description:
Validates records synchronously and doesn't write them to the data lake; intended for development
only. As with upserts, every schema field must be present in each record.

202.description: All records are valid. Nothing is stored

400.description: Validation failed. `details.validationReport` lists each failing record and why.

example.message: Bad Request: JSON is properly formatted but has a mismatch with Schema.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: Field to order jobs by. Defaults to `systemModstamp`

parameters.name: states
parameters.description: Only return jobs in these states (comma-separated)

post.description: Needs an Ingestion API data stream for the object. Limits: 20 jobs per hour, 5 concurrent jobs; jobs left `Open` or `UploadComplete` for more than 7 days are deleted. Returns `409 CONFLICT` while another job for the same object is still open or processing

get.summary: Get a bulk ingestion job's status

delete.description:
Allowed in the `UploadComplete`, `JobComplete`, `Aborted` and `Failed` states. Deletes the job's
data and metadata; it no longer appears in `getJob` or `listJobs`.

patch.summary: Close (UploadComplete) or abort a bulk ingestion job
patch.description:
`UploadComplete` queues the uploaded data for processing; `Aborted` discards it. After either,
no more data can be added. `409` if the job's current state doesn't allow the change.

put.summary: Upload a CSV file to an open bulk ingestion job
put.description:
One CSV file per call, up to 100 files per job, each at most 150 MB (UTF-8, RFC 4180, comma
delimiter). Dates are `yyyy-MM-dd`; date-times `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ`.
- **Upsert jobs:** a header row matching the object's field names. Updates replace the whole
  record (no patch semantics), and empty values become null.
- **Delete jobs:** no header. Column 1 is the primary key. A second column (a date-time later
  than the original record) is needed only when the data stream has a record-version field,
  e.g. Profile category.

Get metadata (fields, indexes, relationships) for one profile data model object
Get a profile record by ID (or by secondary key with `searchKey`)
get.description: Returns an empty `data` list when no record matches.

get.summary: Get a profile's related child records
get.description: Each `data` item is the parent row, with the child record nested under a key named after the child object, e.g. `{"ssot__FirstName__c": "Iris", "ssot__ContactPointEmail__dlm": {"ssot__EmailAddress__c": "…"}}`

parameters.name: childDataModelName
parameters.description: API name of a related child DMO, e.g. `ContactPointEmail__dlm`

get.summary: Get a calculated insight's values for one profile
get.description: Each `data` item is the parent row, with the insight's values nested under a key named after the insight, e.g. `{"ssot__FirstName__c": "Iris", "IndividualSpend__cio": {"total_spend__c": 1250.5}}`

get.summary: Get metadata (dimensions and measures) for all calculated insights
Get metadata (dimensions and measures) for one calculated insight

get.description: Returns at most 4,999 rows per call; page with `limit`, `offset` and `orderby`.

post.description: Runs an ANSI SQL query synchronously over data lake objects, data model objects and calculated insights. Rows come back as arrays of column values in the order given by each column's `placeInOrder`. When `done` is `false`, get the remaining rows with `getNextSqlQueryBatch`

example.sql: SELECT ssot__Id__c, ssot__FirstName__c FROM ssot__Individual__dlm LIMIT 10

get.summary: Get the next batch of SQL query results

type.description: Data type of the field, e.g. `STRING`, `NUMBER`, `DATE_TIME`

FieldMetadata.description: A field, dimension or measure of a data model object or calculated insight

developerName.description: Developer name of the ruleset. Can be `null`

configurationType.description: Type of entity the ruleset unifies, e.g. `individual`

objectApiName.description: API name of the object the ruleset unifies, e.g. `Individual`

dataSpaceName.description: Data space of the ruleset, e.g. `default`

doesRunAutomatically.description: Whether the ruleset runs on its schedule

lastJobStatus.description: Status of the latest run, e.g. `SUCCESS` or `IN_PROGRESS`

lastJobCompleted.description: Completion time of the latest run. `null` if it never completed

matchRules.description: Rules that decide which source records belong to the same profile

reconciliationRules.description: Rules that decide which value a unified profile keeps for each field

IdentityResolutionRuleset.description: An identity resolution ruleset. `developerName` can be `null`; use `id` to run it

AcceptedResponse.description: Acknowledgement that the request was accepted for asynchronous processing

MetadataResponse.description: Metadata of data model objects or calculated insights

success.description: Whether the calculated insight run was started

errors.description: Errors of the calculated insight run, if any

resultCode.description: Outcome of an identity resolution run, e.g. `SuccessfullySubmittedIdentityResolutionJobRunRequest`, `IdentityResolutionJobIsAlreadyRunning`, `NoPendingChangesJobRunSkipped` or `ExceededMaximumNumberOfSuccessfulRunsAllowedIn24Hours`

RunResult.description: Result of a run request. A calculated insight run returns `success` and `errors`; an identity resolution run returns `resultCode`

data.description: The records. Every field defined in the object's schema must be present in each record; date-times need fractional seconds, e.g. `2026-10-24T10:15:30.000Z`

IngestRecords.description: Records to ingest into a streaming Ingestion API object

tenantId.description: ID of the Data Cloud tenant

details.description: Further details, such as a validation report

ErrorResponse.description:
Tenant-endpoint error body, as documented for record validation. Other errors may carry only some
of these fields

data.description: Rows, keyed by field API name.

done.description: True when there are no more rows to page through.

metadata.description: Column metadata, keyed by field API name. Empty when there are no rows

QueryResponse.description: Rows returned by a profile or calculated insight query, keyed by field API name

primaryKeys.description: Primary key fields of the object

latestProcessTime.description: Calculated insights only: time of the latest run. `1970-01-01T00:00:00.00000Z` means the insight has never run

latestSuccessfulProcessTime.description: Calculated insights only: time of the latest successful run

ObjectMetadata.description: Metadata of a data model object or calculated insight

ids.description: Primary keys of the records to delete (max 200)

DeleteRecordsRequest.description: Primary keys of the records to delete

IngestRecord.description: A record whose fields match the object's schema in the Ingestion API connector

object.description: Object the job loads, from the connector's schema

sourceName.description: Name of the Ingestion API connector

apiVersion.description: Ingestion API version, as a string (`"v1"`) or a number

contentUrl.description: Path to upload CSV files to, e.g. `/api/v1/ingest/jobs/{id}/batches`. `null` after the job is closed.

createdById.description: ID of the user who created the job

systemModstamp.description: Last-modified time. Empty (`""`) on a new job, so no `date-time` format is enforced.

retries.description: Number of times the job was retried. `null` once the job is closed

totalProcessingTime.description: Total processing time of the job. `null` once the job is closed

BulkJob.description: A bulk ingestion job. `systemModstamp` is empty on a new job, and `contentUrl`, `retries` and `totalProcessingTime` are `null` once the job is closed

BulkJobList.description: A page of bulk ingestion jobs

BulkJobState.description: State of a bulk ingestion job: `Open` → `UploadComplete` → `InProgress` → `JobComplete` or `Failed`, or `Aborted`

BulkJobOperation.description: Operation a bulk ingestion job performs

sourceName.description: Name of the Ingestion API connector as shown in Data Cloud setup

operation.description: Whether the job upserts or deletes records

object.description: Object name from the connector's schema

CreateBulkJobRequest.description: A bulk ingestion job to create

state.description: `UploadComplete` to queue the uploaded data for processing, or `Aborted` to discard it

UpdateBulkJobStateRequest.description: The state to move a bulk ingestion job to

ObjectIndex.description: A combination of fields available for lookups

name.description: API name of the key field

displayName.description: Display label of the key field

indexOrder.description: Position of the field in the key

PrimaryKeyField.description: A primary key field of the object

fromEntity.description: API name of the object the relationship starts from

toEntity.description: API name of the related object

fromEntityAttribute.description: Field of the starting object that holds the key

toEntityAttribute.description: Field of the related object that the key matches

cardinality.description: Cardinality of the relationship, e.g. `NTOONE` or `ONETOMANY`

ObjectRelationship.description: A relationship from this object to another data model object

IdentityResolutionRulesetList.description: Identity resolution rulesets of the org

record.description: The failing record, as a JSON string

ValidationReportEntry.description: A record that failed validation and the reasons

sql.description: ANSI SQL query, e.g. `SELECT ssot__Id__c FROM ssot__Individual__dlm LIMIT 10`

type.description: SQL type of the column, e.g. `VARCHAR`, `DECIMAL`, `TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE`

placeInOrder.description: Position of the column in each row, starting at 0

typeCode.description: JDBC type code of the column

SqlQueryResponse.description: A batch of SQL query results

data.description: Rows, each an array of column values ordered by the columns' `placeInOrder`

metadata.description: Result columns, keyed by column name

rowCount.description: Number of rows in this batch

done.description: Whether this is the last batch

nextBatchId.description: ID to get the next batch with. `null` when `done` is `true`

example.message: The requested resource does not exist

SourceName.name: sourceName
SourceName.description: Name of the Ingestion API connector as shown in Data Cloud setup, e.g. `CustomerOrders`

ObjectName.name: objectName
ObjectName.description: Object name from the connector's schema

DataModelName.name: dataModelName
DataModelName.description: API name of a profile-category DMO, e.g. `UnifiedIndividual__dlm`

RecordId.name: recordId
RecordId.description: Record ID, or the value of the field named in `searchKey`

CiName.name: insightName
CiName.description: API name of the calculated insight, e.g. `IndividualSpend__cio`

Fields.name: fields
Fields.description: Fields to return (max 50). Without it, only the first 10 fields (alphabetically) come back

Filters.name: filters
Filters.description: Comma-separated equality expressions in square brackets, joined with AND, e.g. `[FirstName__c=Alex,LastName__c=Perera]`. On child and insight lookups they apply to the parent object only

RequiredFilters.name: filters
RequiredFilters.description:
Required. Comma-separated equality expressions in square brackets, joined with AND, e.g.
`[FirstName__c=Alex]`. Date-times as `BirthDate__c=1990-07-12 00:00:00`

ProfileLimit.name: limit
ProfileLimit.description: Rows to return. Default and maximum 49,999

InsightLimit.name: limit
InsightLimit.description: Rows to return. Default and maximum 4,999

Offset.name: offset
Offset.description: Rows to skip before returning. API v52.0+

OrderBy.name: orderby
OrderBy.description: Comma-separated sort, e.g. `GenderId__c ASC, Occupation__c DESC`. API v52.0+

SearchKey.name: searchKey
SearchKey.description: Field to match `recordId` against instead of the primary key, e.g. `ssot__Email__c`

Dimensions.name: dimensions
Dimensions.description: Dimensions to return. Defaults to all

Measures.name: measures
Measures.description: Measures to return. Defaults to all

TimeGranularity.name: timeGranularity
TimeGranularity.description: Rolls measures up to this time range. API v53.0+

OAuth2.description: Salesforce core org OAuth 2.0. The connector uses the core access token directly for the `Runs` endpoints and exchanges it at `POST {core}/services/a360/token` for the Data Cloud token used on the tenant endpoint.
